units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 8b:3">B. Bath. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ קשה וכ׳</he> death in war is a greater affliction than natural death. Snh. 116ᵃ <he>מהם הרגו בח׳</he> some of them they put to death by the sword. Tanḥ. Balak 8; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20:14">Num. R. s. 20</cite> <he>אא״כ שלף חַרְבּוֹ</he> without drawing his sword.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20:14">Ib.</cite> <he>בח׳ חייהם</he> live on their sword.
<cite ref="Mishnah Taanit 3:5">Taan. III, 5</cite> <he>על הח׳</he> on the sword, i.e. when armies are passing the country.
<cite ref="Taanit 22a:17">Ib. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>ח׳ של שלום</he> a friendly army passing; a. fr.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 1:7">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. I, 7</cite>.—Pl. <he>חֲרָבוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 21:1">Pesik. R. s. 21</cite> <he>ח׳ מכאן וכ׳</he> (soldiers with) swords here &c.; a. e.
